findings.title: Nonexistent local times are silently scheduled on DST spring-forward days
findings.evidence: The code constructs the target run time with datetime.combine(..., tzinfo=tz), which does not validate that the requested wall clock time exists in that zone on that date. On spring-forward dates, values like 02:30 in many zones are skipped, so this can return a UTC instant for a run time that never occurs locally.
findings.recommendation: Detect nonexistent local times before returning. One approach is to build the local candidate, round-trip it through UTC back into the target zone, and verify the local date/time still matches the requested wall time; if not, choose and document a policy such as scheduling at the next valid local time or skipping to the following day. Add tests covering DST gap dates in a real zone such as America/New_York.
